content.title: Bodyweight Squat
content.description: A lower-body squat performed without external load.
instructions: Stand with feet about shoulder-width apart.
Bend at the hips and knees while keeping the whole foot grounded and knees tracking in the same direction as the toes.
Lower only as far as you can control, then press through the feet to stand tall.

content.title: Goblet Squat
content.description: A squat variation holding one dumbbell close to the chest.
instructions: Hold one dumbbell vertically against the chest with both hands.
Stand with feet around shoulder-width apart and brace the trunk.
Sit the hips down between the legs while keeping the dumbbell close, then press through the feet to return to standing.

content.title: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
content.description: A hip-hinge exercise using dumbbells to train the posterior chain.
instructions: Stand tall holding dumbbells in front of the thighs, with knees softly bent.
Push the hips back and lower the weights close to the legs while keeping the spine neutral.
Stop when hamstring flexibility allows without rounding the back, then drive the hips forward to stand.

content.title: Reverse Lunge
content.description: A split-stance lower-body exercise stepping backward into a lunge.
instructions: Stand upright with feet hip-width apart.
Step one foot backward and bend both knees only as far as you can keep balance and control.
Press through the front foot to return, then repeat on the other side.

content.title: Glute Bridge
content.description: A floor-based hip-extension exercise using bodyweight.
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat about hip-width apart.
Brace gently and lift the hips by pressing through the feet, keeping the ribs relaxed.
Pause briefly at a comfortable height, then lower the hips with control.

content.title: Standing Calf Raise
content.description: A standing plantar-flexion exercise that can be performed with support for balance.
instructions: Stand tall near a stable support and place your hands on it lightly if needed.
Rise onto the balls of both feet without rolling the ankles outward.
Lower the heels slowly until the feet are flat, then repeat.

content.title: Push-Up
content.description: A horizontal pushing exercise using bodyweight.
instructions: Place hands slightly wider than shoulder-width and extend the legs behind you, or use a knee-supported position.
Keep the body in a straight line and bend the elbows to lower the chest under control.
Press the floor away to return without letting the hips sag.

content.title: Incline Push-Up
content.description: A horizontal pushing variation with the hands elevated on a fixed surface.
instructions: Place both hands on a stable bench or counter and step back until the body forms a straight line.
Bend the elbows to bring the chest toward the surface while keeping the trunk steady.
Press through the hands to return to the start position.

content.title: Dumbbell Floor Press
content.description: A horizontal chest press performed lying on the floor with dumbbells.
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and hold a dumbbell in each hand above the chest.
Lower the weights until the upper arms gently touch the floor, keeping wrists stacked over elbows.
Press the dumbbells upward without bouncing the arms off the floor.

content.title: One-Arm Dumbbell Row
content.description: A single-arm horizontal pulling exercise supported by a bench or stable surface.
instructions: Support one hand on a stable bench and hinge forward with a neutral back.
Hold a dumbbell in the other hand and pull it toward the lower ribs without twisting the trunk.
Lower the weight slowly, complete the repetitions, then switch sides.

content.title: Resistance-Band Row
content.description: A horizontal pulling exercise using a securely anchored resistance band.
instructions: Anchor the band securely at about chest height and hold one end in each hand.
Stand or sit tall with arms extended and shoulders relaxed.
Pull the hands toward the ribs while drawing the shoulder blades gently back, then return slowly.

content.description: A vertical pushing exercise pressing dumbbells overhead from shoulder level.
instructions: Stand or sit tall with dumbbells at shoulder height and wrists straight.
Brace the trunk and press the weights overhead in a controlled path.
Lower the weights to shoulder height without arching the lower back.

content.title: Dumbbell Biceps Curl
content.description: An elbow-flexion exercise holding dumbbells at the sides.
instructions: Stand with a dumbbell in each hand, arms by your sides and palms facing forward or slightly inward.
Bend the elbows to curl the weights while keeping the upper arms close to the torso.
Lower the weights slowly until the arms are nearly straight.

content.description: An elbow-extension exercise holding one dumbbell overhead.
instructions: Hold one dumbbell securely with both hands and raise it overhead.
Keep the upper arms near the head as you bend the elbows to lower the weight behind you within a comfortable range.
Straighten the elbows to return the weight overhead without flaring the ribs.

content.title: Dead Bug
content.description: A supine trunk-control exercise moving opposite arm and leg while maintaining a comfortable neutral spine.
instructions: Lie on your back with arms above the shoulders and hips and knees bent.
Brace gently and lower one arm and the opposite leg only as far as you can keep the trunk steady.
Return to the start and alternate sides; reduce the range if the back arches.

content.title: Front Plank
content.description: An isometric trunk exercise supported on forearms and toes or knees.
instructions: Place forearms on the floor with elbows under the shoulders; extend the legs or keep knees down for an easier variation.
Align the head, trunk and hips and breathe steadily while bracing gently.
End the hold when you can no longer maintain the position without discomfort.

content.title: Side Plank
content.description: An isometric lateral trunk exercise supported on one forearm and the side of the feet or knees.
instructions: Lie on one side with the forearm under the shoulder; bend the knees for a supported variation.
Lift the hips until the shoulder, hips and knees or ankles form a line.
Hold while breathing steadily, lower with control, then switch sides.

content.title: Bird Dog
content.description: A quadruped stability exercise extending the opposite arm and leg.
instructions: Start on hands and knees with hands under shoulders and knees under hips.
Extend one arm and the opposite leg while keeping the trunk steady and hips facing the floor.
Return slowly and alternate sides; use a shorter reach if balance is difficult.

content.title: Lat Pulldown
content.description: A vertical pulling exercise using a cable machine and overhead bar attachment.
instructions: Sit securely at the machine and hold the bar with a comfortable, even grip.
Draw the shoulders down and pull the bar toward the upper chest without leaning far backward.
Return the bar overhead slowly until the arms are extended comfortably.
